name: foxrun
description: Set up Foxrun, open agent threads, and ask Foxrun how it works.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Foxrun and open agent threads
interface.longDescription: Foxrun keeps your agents' work in one place: workspaces, memory, and tracked tasks. This plugin carries three skills. setup installs the Foxrun core with uv, then reruns its questions, threads, hooks, and backup. thread opens a titled agent session in its workspace. ask answers how Foxrun does something from its own pages.
defaultPrompt: Make a thread for my workspace lead.
How does Foxrun keep memory between sessions?
